verdict.rationale: telli documents custom tools that let agents reach external information by connecting to your APIs. Its tool-calls docs show tools running during live calls, such as web_search and transfer tools, so the core of mid-conversation function calling is delivered. The evidence never addresses how the agent handles latency while a tool runs, so the "no awkward dead air" part is unsupported. Missing for 10: evidence of latency handling or filler speech during tool execution, detailed custom-tool schema/configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
